# LayerAI Docs

> LayerAI is a local-first browser extension for web content collection, AI translation, glossary governance, and cloud collaboration.

## Site

- Docs: https://sovitech.mintlify.app
- MCP: https://sovitech.mintlify.app/mcp
- GitHub: https://github.com/houguang/layerai-docs

## Quick links

- [Introduction](https://sovitech.mintlify.app/introduction)
- [Install](https://sovitech.mintlify.app/journey/install)
- [First translation](https://sovitech.mintlify.app/journey/first-translation)

## Structure

Source documentation lives under `docs/` with navigation in `docs.json`.
